independence: Actual held texts read independently; producer workpapers used as discovery inventories only. No candidate opened before this source audit.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete original, paragraphs 1-7 and signature; surrounding contents excluded.
sources_checked.finding: Six substantive original rules. Paragraph 7 supplies express retroactive activation 1947-09-01. Four-year staff appointment eligibility, two-month notice and thirty-day individual waiver are not whole-order sunsets. Paragraph 6 requires consultation and prior State concurrence for later regulation changes as to existing personnel.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, PDF pages 321-330; section 5.4 bridge separately reread after truncated display; all operative original amendment, continuation and effective provisions read.
sources_checked.finding: Section 2-101(b) expressly includes EO9932 in CSC to OPM substitution; section 2-404 makes the amendment effective 1979-01-01. This changes administrator, not a first cessation. Personnel-action continuation and other savings are scoped and not universal proof of EO9932 survival.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, PDF pages 11-12.
sources_checked.finding: Section 10(d) expressly revokes EO9932. Section 11 makes order effective 1981-02-15 despite signing on 1981-02-23. Sections 5,7,8 specifically change section 528 references to 1980 Act section 310; actual statutory replacement, transition and accrued-rights effects remain open.

sources_checked.read_extent: Rule III and immediately surrounding Rules II and IV, extracted characters 25000-32000; complete order not claimed read.
sources_checked.finding: Actual Rule III contains several eligibility routes. Cannot equate a changed appointment label with exhaustion of all status claims.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order through signature; neighboring agricultural material excluded; initially truncated definition bridge reread.
sources_checked.finding: Replaces civil service rules, converts appointment categories, revokes EO9830 Part II and named other orders; no express blanket EO9932 revocation. Pending versus acquired statuses remain unresolved.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete EO10217 and complete neighboring CSC section 2.115(a).
sources_checked.finding: Actual EO amends EO10157; adjacent CSC regulation converts indefinite appointments from 1950-12-01. Separate regulation identity matters; no inferred global end.

sources_checked.read_extent: Only complete neighboring CSC Part 25 section 25.225 War transfer regulation, 13 FR 3335 PDF page 3; unrelated EO9970 not relied on.
sources_checked.finding: Neighboring pay regulation expressly includes EO9932 employment within war transfer. It is not an EO9970 lifecycle act.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order through signature, 24 FR 4159-4161 PDF pages 1-3.
sources_checked.finding: Thirty-month limit for persons henceforth serving overseas under Mutual Security Act section 527(c), unless agency agrees otherwise; statutory intersection remains open.

sources_checked.read_extent: Header; sections 302-306 through signature (characters 15100-21100), plus discovery contexts. Other foreign-aid delegations not claimed read.
sources_checked.finding: Carries program-specific thirty-month condition; supersedes named aid orders and saves compatible prior actions. No global EO9932 end.

sources_checked.read_extent: Header; sections 601-607, particularly full personnel, supersession, savings and effective provisions (characters 11700-end). Other delegations not claimed read.
sources_checked.finding: Thirty-month condition for post-May-19-1959 appointments under specified aid acts with agency agreement exception. Limited supersession and savings; no global EO9932 end.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, PDF pages 3-6; section 5(c) program-specific reemployment rule read with entire order.
sources_checked.finding: Section 5(c) gives educational/cultural program employees section 528-equivalent benefits subject to thirty-month exception and agency agreement; not all EO9932 employees.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, PDF pages 5-7.
sources_checked.finding: Peace Corps/Mutual Security reemployment limitation is program-specific and subject to agency agreement. Scoped savings; no global EO9932 end.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, PDF pages 5-6.
sources_checked.finding: Provides an additional competitive-appointment/status route for qualifying former unlimited career Foreign Service employees. Does not extinguish EO9932 limited-term category.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order through signature, PDF pages 5-6.
sources_checked.finding: OPIC reinstatement/restoration and compatible prior-action continuity are specific functions, not a global resolution of EO9932 accrued rights.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, PDF pages 11-15, in two consecutive ranges.
sources_checked.finding: Continues Peace Corps reemployment limitation and scoped savings while superseding named Peace Corps orders; no global EO9932 end.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, PDF pages 9-12, in two consecutive ranges.
sources_checked.finding: Section 1-401 carries Peace Corps thirty-month limitation; 1-701 scoped savings; actual 1-707 effective 1979-05-16. Does not establish EO9932 first end.

sources_checked.read_extent: Header; sections 1-6 through 1-9 and signature (characters 15000-28900), notably 1-602(b), 1-903, 1-904 and 1-905. Other delegations not claimed read.
sources_checked.finding: Section 1-602(b) carries aid-program thirty-month limit; 1-903 revokes aid orders; 1-904 scoped savings. Does not establish EO9932 first end.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, PDF pages 11-15.
sources_checked.finding: Foreign Commercial Service personnel authority and statutory applicability are specific to transferred functions; no express EO9932 cessation.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, paragraphs 1-3 and signature on PDF page 4; neighboring proclamation and retirement rule not relied on.
sources_checked.finding: Independent additional material hit omitted from producer read inventory: paragraph 2 expressly exempts past/future EO9932 reemployment rights from this order. Its six-month expiration therefore supplies no EO9932 first end; eventual residual disposition remains unresolved.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, PDF pages 13-14.
sources_checked.finding: Independent additional related actor under 1980 Act; delegates administration, preserves pending-conversion pay/benefits authority and uses 1981-02-15 effective date. Does not revive EO9932 or settle its accrued rights.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete subpart E sections 352.501-352.508, including authority and source notes, characters 37738 through beginning Subpart F. Initial part B context also read; complete 18-page extract not claimed read.
sources_checked.finding: Distinct Foreign Assistance Act sections 233(d)/625(b) reinstatement scheme includes former Foreign Service appointees. Does not resolve the original section 522(2)/528 replacement or imply EO9932 revival.

original_inventory.exact_quote:
1 . Any officer of employee of the Gov­
ernment assigned to the Foreign Service 
as a Foreign Service Reserve Officer in 
accordance with section 522 (2) of the 
Foreign Service Act of 1946 who was at 
the time of his assignment an officer or 
employee of the Government serving un­
der a war service indefinite or temporary 
indefinite appointment and who is 
reached in regular order for probational 
appointment from a Civil Service regis­
ter appropriate for filling the position in 
which he was serving at the time of as­
signment or who could, with the approval 
of the head of the agency in which he 
was serving, have been given a competi­
tive status under Civil Service Rule III 
if he had remained in his former position, 
shall be considered as having a competi­
tive status as of the date he is reached 
for probational appointment or classifi­
cation.

2. Any officer or employee of the Gov­
ernment who is appointed, at the request 
of the head of the agency in which he 
was serving, as a Foreign Service Staff 
Officer or employee for a period limited in 
duration to four years or less shall be 
entitled to the same rights with regard 
to acquisitiortof a competitive status as is 
provided by section 1  of this order, and 
any such officer or employee who has, or 
acquires, a competitive status shall be 
entitled to the same rights with regard 
to reinstatement in such agency as a per­
son who is assigned to the Foreign Serv­
ice as a Foreign Service Reserve Officer 
is entitled to receive under the terms of 
section 528 of the Foreign Service Act of 
1946.

3. Whenever an agency fills a position 
previously occupied by a Foreign Service 
Reserve Officer or a Foreign Service Staff 
Officer or employee entitled to reinstate­
ment in such agency under the provi­
sions of the Foreign Service Act of 1946 
and this order, the appointment, promo­
tion, transfer, or other personnel action 
shall be made on a temporary basis pend­
ing the return of the officer or employee 
in question.

4. The Department of State shall, at 
least two months prior to the completion 
of the service of a Foreign Service Re­
serve Officer, Staff Officer, or employee 
entitled to reinstatement under the pro­
visions of the Foreign Service Act of 1946 
or of this order, notify the officer or em­
ployee and the head of the agency in 
which the officer or employee was serv­
ing immediately prior to his assignment 
to the Foreign Service of the proposed 
termination of assignment in the Foreign 
Service, and such agency shall, prior to 
the termination of assignment in the 
Foreign Service, make arrangements for 
the return to duty of such officer or em­
ployee.

5. A person shall be deemed to have 
waived his rights to reinstatement under 
the terms of section 528 of the Foreign 
Service Act of 1946 and the terms of this 
order if he accepts at the termination of 
his period of service in the Foreign Serv­
ice a position elsewhere than in the Gov­
ernment agency in which he has previ­
ously served or fails to avail himself of 
his right to reinstatement within thirty 
days after the end of his period of service 
in the Foreign Service.

6. The Civil Service Commission is 
authorized, after consultation with the 
Department of State, to prescribe such 
rules and regulations as may be neces­
sary to carry out the provisions of this 
order: Provided, that any changes in 
such rules and regulations made subse­
quent to the appointment or assignment 
of personnel for duty with the Foreign 
Service shall not be effective as to such 
personnel without the prior concurrence 
of the Department of Stated

7. This order shall become effective as 
of September 1, 1947.
